basis: Authorize the design-language convergence epic. The migrated QA Pilot frontend works functionally and has original QA Pilot assets restored, but should adopt the newer Librarian dashboard design quality standards — cleaner card hierarchy, bento-style layout, calmer spacing, native-feeling panels, clear readiness/status strips, restrained motion, readable typography, strong action hierarchy — while preserving QA Pilot's browser-only deployment, Academy/training identity, JSON import/export custody, local learner identity, and no backend/auth/install constraints.

epic_sequence.purpose: Create design-language baseline comparing QA Pilot browser assets against Librarian dashboard design language. Define shared vs QA Pilot-specific rules. Fix two known validation defects as baseline hygiene.
Update shared CSS tokens, page shell, typography, spacing, header, and cards.
Redesign admin.html around a dashboard/bento layout.
Refresh catalog.html and identity.html for learner onboarding and course discovery.
Refresh course-view.html with better lesson navigation, source references, progress, and checkpoint surfaces.
Re-run full 22-step workflow and design/i18n validation.

design_direction: Use the current Librarian dashboard design language as the quality reference: bento/card hierarchy, calmer spacing, native-feeling panels, clear readiness/status strips, restrained motion, readable typography, strong but not noisy action hierarchy, consistent light theme, polished Owner/Admin/Learner workflows. QA Pilot must retain Academy/training identity, browser-only static deployment, JSON import/export custody, local learner identity only.
defects_to_repair: Defect #1 (medium): EN/FR language toggle does not render because renderLangToggle() is called with a DOM element object instead of the expected string container ID.
Defect #2 (low): export.html and import.html missing QA Pilot Academy title branding and favicon references.
